authorization: Ju authorized execution of the jointly discussed plan on 2026-11-12. Phase one performs local input-only audit and an already-exposed development-only node profile.

primary.evaluation_population: The eligible official-dev subset after predeclared historical exposure and normalized premise/input exclusions; not the full original official-dev population
primary.quota_semantics: offline batch ranking; floor(0.1*N); fixed sample_id tie break; includes forced front failures within quota or fails the primary cell if forced failures alone exceed quota
primary.fit_size: largest approved nested size; proposed 18000 pending whole-premise role-allocation feasibility

fitting.superseded_proposal: 1800/8000/24000; 24000 equal-round/class is infeasible after current exclusions
fitting.strata: equal round and class quotas with deterministic remainder rule, fixed across sizes
fitting.reuse: Historical train-only fitting/selection/development inputs may be reused for fitting if disjoint from both new evaluation pools and all official-test premises
fitting.new_evaluation: Exclude every historical USED premise/input and isolate both evaluation pools from each other and all fitting/selection inputs
fitting.head_family_proposal: difference of two regularized correctness logistic heads; identical family, optimizer and tuning budget in both arms
fitting.text_representation_proposal: one frozen encoder; candidate is the already pinned all-MiniLM-L6-v2; exact features, regularization and selection budget require a final protocol revision before fitting
fitting.selection_budget: pending group-allocation feasibility; recorded separately from fitting labels

secondary.other_evaluation: new train-source premise-disjoint holdout, separately sealed
secondary.weighting_limit: Round standardization cannot recover excluded examples or remove within-round historical-selection bias
secondary.deployment: freeze a selection-trained threshold allowing zero deferrals; report actual rate, net gain and direct-model comparisons separately from offline ranking

inference_limits.uncertainty_unit: normalized premise cluster, paired across arms; quota recomputed in bootstrap batches
inference_limits.minimum_useful_effect: pending pre-evaluation justification; 1 percentage point remains a candidate, not an accepted equivalence margin
inference_limits.low_power_action: retain the primary population and report precision/inconclusiveness; do not promote a secondary population after seeing scores
inference_limits.generalization: conditional on eligible subset, tested recipes and released checkpoints; no causal isolation of distribution shift or pretraining contamination

phase_one.profile_inputs: the 90 already-exposed V3 development examples; official train only
phase_one.profile_only: sequential single-model feasibility, exact tokens, startup and collection cost; no new evaluation gold, router fitting or SLO claims

formal_gates_pending: record outside-machine/team exposure status; local input audit is complete within its declared scope
approve whole-premise fitting/selection/train-holdout allocation and nested quotas
review real node development-profile bundle and a representative train-only cost sample if needed
fix encoder provenance, features, optimizer, search limits, seeds, failure handling and all data hashes
fix primary inference rules, minimum useful effect and final-evaluation access receipt
independent implementation acceptance before formal collection/fitting/evaluation

optional_scope.task_finetuned_encoder: not included in phase one; decide before final protocol freeze and before new evaluation access
optional_scope.online_service: conditional on prespecified development-stage quality/cost criteria; separate protocol
